status: future recipe assignments over the implemented canonical sound profiles

canonicalIdentity.rule: id and worldId are copied exactly from the generated canonical index. Never introduce a second identity namespace, seed or frequency table.

baselineImplementation.recipe: three sine voices through a low-pass filter
baselineImplementation.parameters: Resolve canonical profile fields from the module or generated index; intentionally not duplicated here.
baselineImplementation.default: ambience, action sounds and haptics off
baselineImplementation.narration: ambient gain ducks to 0.18 while the reader is playing/starting
baselineImplementation.visibility: stops active nodes and suspends while hidden; resumes enabled audio on return
baselineImplementation.status: implemented source; audible/device quality not certified
baselineImplementation.globalControls: Header SOUND / SOUND · ON on every page, with accessible effect-state label and settings dialog
baselineImplementation.effectsOffScope: TURN EFFECTS OFF stops ambience, action sounds and haptics; narration has separate Reader controls

proposalBoundary.releaseRule: Audition and version the richer renderer independently. Any canonical identity/tuning change requires the owning SOUNDSCAPE_VERSION migration, not a docs override.
proposalBoundary.perceptualDistinctness: Unique source identities and tuples do not establish audible distinctness; test released motifs with listeners.

proposedPlaybackEnhancements.optionalQuietReading: mute ambient through reader pause as well as speech; a preference beyond baseline ducking

recipes.recipe: 2–3 sine partials; a softly enveloped upper partial appears infrequently.
recipes.character: quiet clear tones, long air between gestures

recipes.recipe: 3 additive sine tones with slow, shallow changes in partial balance; no beat grid.
2 sine and 1 low-passed triangle voice; staggered long envelopes, no clicks.
One steady sine below very quiet band-limited deterministic noise; no field recording.
recipes.character: soft hollow texture without water imitation

recipes.recipe: 2 rounded additive tones with long attacks/releases and little stereo separation.
recipes.character: restrained low-mid resonance, no physiological pulse

recipes.recipe: Up to 3 soft partials in sparse clusters; long silent or nearly silent intervals.
recipes.character: distant discrete harmonic gestures, no alarm
